messages.text: Reminder: strawberries make my throat swell up. Have an EpiPen, would prefer not to use it. Also — completely unrelated — what's the best way to get from Lisbon to Porto without renting a car?

Got the strawberry note — locked in. For Lisbon-to-Porto, the high-speed Alfa Pendular train is the obvious answer. About 2h45m, runs roughly hourly from Lisboa Oriente or Santa Apolónia stations to Porto Campanhã, costs around €25–35 in second class if you book a day or two ahead. Reserve seats online at cp.pt. It's far more relaxed than driving and you skip Porto's miserable city-center traffic entirely.
